h1: Apartelle Jatujak Hotel — Stylish Budget Apartelle Near Ha Yaek Ladprao with Free Shuttle to Everywhere
intro: Soi Ladprao 1 sounds quiet, but it sits just 7 minutes on foot from BTS Ha Yaek Ladprao, steps from Union Mall, and within reach of a free hotel shuttle that runs to MRT Phahon Yothin, Lotus, and area malls all day — Apartelle Jatujak Hotel is a 30-room, 3-star boutique property opened in 2018 with a clear concept: designer rooms with a full kitchenette, 42-inch Smart TV with free Netflix, private balcony, and a 24-hour free snack lounge. From approx. ฿1,200/night. Scored 9.4 from 332 reviews on Trip.com.

body.html: Ha Yaek Ladprao — or the Ladprao Five-Way Intersection — is where the BTS Sukhumvit Line meets the MRT Blue Line, making it one of Bangkok's most connected transit hubs. From here you can reach Siam in 15 minutes, Asok in 20, and Chatuchak Weekend Market in under 10. Apartelle Jatujak Hotel tucks itself one short alley off that junction, in Soi Ladprao 1, placing guests right beside Union Mall and only steps from the main road — a deceptively quiet setting with everything you need at arm's reach.

What sets this property apart from other budget options in the neighbourhood is design quality that doesn't match the price tag. Every room — Deluxe Plus, Executive Modern, Premium Twin, and Premium Double — comes with a full kitchenette (microwave, fridge, coffee and tea maker), a laptop-safe safe, a 42-inch Smart TV with free Netflix, and a private balcony. Floors are polished concrete in an industrial-loft style; reviewers consistently praise cleanliness that holds up across different weeks and seasons, not just on opening days.
"Room was spotless, staff went above and beyond, and the free shuttle made getting to the MRT so easy. Will definitely be back — outstanding value for Bangkok."

The free shuttle within a 2-kilometre radius is genuinely the standout feature at Apartelle Jatujak. Guests message the hotel via WhatsApp and a car arrives to take them to MRT Phahon Yothin, Union Mall, Lotus supermarket, or any nearby destination — this service is mentioned in review after review as the detail that makes the property worth more than the price. The second-floor lounge, open 24 hours with complimentary coffee, tea, snacks and instant noodles, is another genuine touch. Guests arriving on a late flight or leaving on an early train particularly appreciate it.

The immediate surroundings offer plenty of options. Union Mall is practically at the mouth of the soi for affordable food and daily essentials. Central Plaza Ladprao — Bangkok's large full-format mall — is reachable in about 5 minutes on the hotel shuttle. Chatuchak Weekend Market is a short ride via MRT. BTS Ha Yaek Ladprao is about 7 minutes' walk, or request the shuttle. MRT Phahon Yothin sits 1.3 km away — again, the shuttle eliminates any friction on hot Bangkok days.

To be honest about the trade-offs based on real guest feedback: there is no pool, no restaurant, and no breakfast service. Most guests don't mind because Union Mall and nearby food courts cover all needs affordably. Noise is the other consistent note — some reviewers report thin walls between rooms. If you're a light sleeper, request an upper-floor room or a quieter side during check-in. A few reviews also mention a mild drain odour in some bathrooms, a plumbing issue the property can address.

For value-conscious travellers or those working from Bangkok who want a clean, design-forward base near great transit links, the numbers speak: 9.4 out of 10 from 332 Trip.com reviews, 9.2 from 514 Booking.com reviews. Designer rooms with kitchenette, attentive staff, free shuttle, and 24-hour snack lounge — all from approximately ฿1,200/night. In the Ha Yaek Ladprao area, that's a package that is genuinely hard to match at this price point.

honestSummary: Apartelle Jatujak Hotel punches above its price class — designer rooms, a full kitchenette, attentive staff, and a free shuttle that genuinely works. It is best suited to independent travellers and business visitors who value clean, well-designed accommodation with strong transit access but don't need a pool or in-house restaurant. Those wanting resort-style amenities should look at 4–5 star options in the area.
honestChecks: If you are a light sleeper — walls can be thin between rooms; request an upper-floor room or a quieter side at check-in and note this preference when booking.
If breakfast is non-negotiable — the hotel has no restaurant; Union Mall at the end of the soi has inexpensive Thai breakfast options and a 7-Eleven for quick fixes.
If MRT Phahon Yothin is key to your route — the walk is ~1.3 km (about 15 minutes); use the hotel's free WhatsApp shuttle instead, especially during Bangkok's hot midday hours.

faq.q: Where is Apartelle Jatujak Hotel and how close is it to BTS/MRT?
faq.a: The hotel is at 69 Soi Ladprao 1, Chatuchak, Bangkok. BTS Ha Yaek Ladprao is approximately 7 minutes' walk. MRT Phahon Yothin is 1.3 km away — use the hotel's free shuttle via WhatsApp for easy access.

faq.q: What is the starting price at Apartelle Jatujak Hotel?
faq.a: Rooms start from approximately ฿1,200/night for a Deluxe Plus Room. Prices vary by date and season — compare across Agoda, Booking.com, and Trip.com before booking to find the best rate.

faq.q: Does Apartelle Jatujak Hotel really offer a free shuttle? Where does it go?
faq.a: Yes — the free shuttle operates within a 2-km radius covering MRT Phahon Yothin, Union Mall, Lotus supermarket, and nearby locations. Request via WhatsApp (number provided at check-in). Guests consistently rate this as the hotel's best feature.

faq.q: Is there breakfast and a swimming pool at Apartelle Jatujak Hotel?
faq.a: No pool and no breakfast restaurant. However, the 24-hour lounge on the 2nd floor provides free coffee, tea and snacks. Union Mall at the end of the soi has inexpensive Thai breakfast options and a convenience store.

faq.q: Who is Apartelle Jatujak Hotel best suited for?
faq.a: Best for solo travellers, business visitors, or couples who want clean, design-forward accommodation with good transit access at a budget-friendly price. Guests who need a pool or in-house restaurant should consider 4–5 star options nearby.
